description: Golden parity cases for the lib/github-status predicates (#252): each case's shell function, its arguments (a JSON string is passed as its text, any other value as jq -c prints it) and the status (0, or 1 for any failure) and output it gives. test/oneshot-predicates-parity.bats checks the shell side and Credfeto.Orchestrator.Predicates.Tests the .NET port. patterns, definitions and settings are lib/globals' values the cases were generated with.

definitions._JQ_DEF_COUNTED_LOGIN: def counted_login($l): ($trusted == null or ($trusted | index($l)) != null) and ($me == "" or $l != $me);
